title: How Lufthansa Shapes Data-Driven Transformation Leaders
description: Lufthansa knew it had to do more to become truly data-driven. The airline’s data experts were struggling to get everyone behind the company’s transformation goals, and data and AI literacy was low. The organization felt that turning all of its leaders into data leaders would be key to its future success. In creating a data leadership program, Lufthansa learned much about the roles that different people play in data-driven change. Its approach has lessons for others facing similar challenges.
translatedDescription: Lufthansa sabía que tenía que hacer más para volverse realmente basado en datos. Los expertos en datos de la aerolínea lucharon por conseguir que todo el mundo estuviera detrás de los objetivos de transformación de la empresa, y los datos y la alfabetización de AI eran bajos. La organización consideró que convertir a todos sus líderes en líderes de datos sería clave para su éxito futuro. Al crear un programa de liderazgo de datos, Lufthansa aprendió mucho sobre los roles que juegan diferentes personas en el cambio basado en datos. Su enfoque tiene lecciones para otros que enfrentan desafíos similares.

title: Case Studies in Strategic Planning
description: This book shows how systematic strategic planning can be used in real-life cases, regardless of a person's level of expertise. The simplified version of this methodology and its analysis tools, based on fundamentals, are easily understood and universally applied to any type of business for developing strategic plans. More importantly, this methodology guides readers in identifying the circumstances in which they might use particular tools, use them effectively, and target them directly at achieving effective results.
translatedDescription: Este libro muestra cómo la planificación estratégica sistemática se puede utilizar en casos reales, independientemente del nivel de experiencia de una persona. La versión simplificada de esta metodología y sus herramientas de análisis, basadas en fundamentos, se entienden fácilmente y se aplican universalmente a cualquier tipo de negocio para desarrollar planes estratégicos. Más importante aún, esta metodología guía a los lectores en la identificación de las circunstancias en las que podrían utilizar instrumentos particulares, utilizarlos eficazmente y orientarlos directamente hacia el logro de resultados eficaces.

title: The Routledge Companion to Business Ethics
description: This Companion provides a novel overview of the discipline of business ethics, covering the major areas of the field as well as new and emerging topics. Led by a well-respected editorial team, this unique volume gathers an international array of experts whose various critical approaches yield insights that are applied to business and philosophy.
translatedDescription: Este Companion ofrece una nueva visión general de la disciplina de la ética empresarial, que abarca las principales áreas del campo, así como temas nuevos y emergentes. Dirigido por un equipo editorial bien respetado, este volumen único reúne una gama internacional de expertos cuyos diversos enfoques críticos producen ideas que se aplican a los negocios y la filosofía.

title: Public Relations, 4th Edition
description: The leading introduction to public relations has been thoroughly revised and updated to reflect best contemporary practice in this increasingly influential profession.
translatedDescription: La introducción líder en las relaciones públicas ha sido revisada y actualizada a fondo para reflejar la mejor práctica contemporánea en esta profesión cada vez más influyente.

title: How to Have Better Strategy Conversations About Monetizing Data
description: Many organizations fail to make good decisions about their data monetization strategies because their leaders lack a shared understanding of how to discuss them. This confusion can impede efforts to derive more value from the company’s data assets through improvements or innovation. This article shares a simple, practical matrix approach that can help remove friction from discussions about monetizing data and identify areas of business opportunity, now and in the future.
translatedDescription: Muchas organizaciones no toman buenas decisiones sobre sus estrategias de monetización de datos porque sus líderes carecen de una comprensión compartida de cómo discutirlos. Esta confusión puede obstaculizar los esfuerzos para obtener más valor de los activos de datos de la empresa mediante mejoras o innovación. Este artículo comparte un enfoque simple de matriz práctica que puede ayudar a eliminar la fricción de las discusiones sobre la monetización de datos e identificar áreas de oportunidad de negocio, ahora y en el futuro.

title: Public Relations Theory
description:
The comprehensive guide to applied PR theory in the 21st century

Public Relations Theory explores the central principles and theoretical components of public relations and their practical applications in actual situations. This informative text helps readers to understand the concepts, approaches, and perspectives of PR theory and learn development methods, implementation strategies, management techniques, and more. Chapters written by recognized experts on each topic provide readers with knowledge on how, when, and why appropriate theories are applied. Focusing on how organizations and individuals integrate theory in a public relations framework, each chapter explains one function, explores its potential challenges and opportunities, provides an example of the function in practice, and offers discussion questions and additional reading suggestions. 

Unique in structure, this text arranges chapters by function, rather than theory, allowing readers to see how multiple theories can be applied to each public relations function and how theories can be used in different professional settings. Comprehensive treatment of topics including social and emerging media, globalization, public diplomacy, corporate and investor relations, and others ensures relevant and timely coverage of contemporary PR issues.

Demonstrates how public relations theory is applied in real-world practice
Illustrates how successfully applied public relations theories lead to positive outcomes
Discusses the relevance of public relations with accessible and engaging language
Offers multiple perspectives from leading international public relations scholars
Includes pedagogical tools including chapter discussion questions, practical examples, tables, and suggested reading lists

Public Relations Theory: Application and Understanding is suitable for instructors and graduate and advanced undergraduate students in courses on public relations theory, as well as practitioners seeking further knowledge on the most current developments in the field.
translatedDescription:
La guía integral de la teoría de PR aplicada en el siglo XXI

Relaciones públicas La teoría explora los principios centrales y los componentes teóricos de las relaciones públicas y sus aplicaciones prácticas en situaciones reales. Este texto informativo ayuda a los lectores a comprender los conceptos, enfoques y perspectivas de la teoría de las relaciones públicas y a aprender métodos de desarrollo, estrategias de implementación, técnicas de gestión y más. Los capítulos escritos por expertos reconocidos sobre cada tema proporcionan a los lectores conocimientos sobre cómo, cuándo y por qué se aplican teorías apropiadas. Centrándose en cómo las organizaciones y los individuos integran la teoría en un marco de relaciones públicas, cada capítulo explica una función, explora sus posibles retos y oportunidades, proporciona un ejemplo de la función en la práctica, y ofrece preguntas de debate y sugerencias de lectura adicionales.

Único en estructura, este texto organiza capítulos por función, en lugar de teoría, permitiendo a los lectores ver cómo se pueden aplicar múltiples teorías a cada función de relaciones públicas y cómo se pueden utilizar teorías en diferentes entornos profesionales. El tratamiento integral de temas como los medios sociales y emergentes, la globalización, la diplomacia pública, las relaciones corporativas e inversionistas, y otros asegura una cobertura relevante y oportuna de las cuestiones de relaciones públicas contemporáneas.

Demuestra cómo se aplica la teoría de las relaciones públicas en la práctica del mundo real
Ilustra cómo las teorías de las relaciones públicas aplicadas con éxito conducen a resultados positivos
Discusses the relevance of public relations with accessible and engaging language
Ofrece múltiples perspectivas de los principales académicos de relaciones públicas internacionales
Incluye instrumentos pedagógicos que incluyen cuestiones de discusión de capítulos, ejemplos prácticos, cuadros y listas de lectura sugeridas

Teoría de Relaciones Públicas: Aplicación y Entendimiento es adecuado para instructores y estudiantes graduados y avanzados en cursos de teoría de relaciones públicas, así como profesionales que buscan más conocimiento sobre los desarrollos más actuales en el campo.

title: Reimagining Nonprofits and Philanthropy
description:
Forward-thinking solutions to the foundational problems plaguing the world of modern nonprofits

Going where many dare not, Reimagining Nonprofit and Philanthropy: Unlocking the Full Potential of a Vital and Complex Sector challenges existing sacred cows across a variety of issues relevant to nonprofit and philanthropy. Each chapter delves into a specific area of work (fundraising, boards, hiring, and so on), analyzes the challenges, and provides concrete solutions for change.

Written by Vu Le, former nonprofit executive and thought leader in the field, this book features leaders doing new things that go against the grain and is written in an easy-to-digest, oftentimes humorous tone. Readers will be left fired up, with their existing notions challenged, ready to flip over some tables and (figuratively) burn some systems down.

Le explores topics including:

Scarcity, martyrdom, and learned helplessness, separating vision and mission, and “bizsplaining” to the corporate sector
The folly of Robert's Rules of Order and reimagining governance through evolutionary and minimally-viable boards
New leadership decision-making models, shifting away from the hierarchical model into a more distributed one

Reimagining Nonprofit and Philanthropy: Unlocking the Full Potential of a Vital and Complex Sector is an essential read for all nonprofit leaders, professionals, and donors who are looking to completely reimagine the way nonprofits think, operate, and make an impact.
translatedDescription:
Soluciones orientadas hacia el futuro a los problemas fundamentales que acarician el mundo de las organizaciones sin fines de lucro modernas

Hacia donde muchos no se atreven, Reimagining Sin ánimo de lucro y Filantropía: desbloquear el potencial completo de un sector vital y complejo desafíos existentes vacas sagradas en una variedad de cuestiones relevantes para la filosofía y sin ánimo de lucro. Cada capítulo profundiza en un área específica de trabajo (recuperación de fondos, juntas, contratación, etc.), analiza los retos y ofrece soluciones concretas para el cambio.

Escrito por Vu Le, ex ejecutivo sin fines de lucro y líder del pensamiento en el campo, este libro cuenta con líderes haciendo cosas nuevas que van contra el grano y está escrito en un tono fácil de digerir, a menudo humorístico. Los lectores serán despedidos, con sus nociones existentes desafiadas, listos para voltear algunas tablas y (figurativamente) quemar algunos sistemas.

Le explora temas incluyendo:

Scarcity, martyrdom, and learned helplessness, separating vision and mission, and “bizsplaining” to the corporate sector
La locura de las reglas del orden de Robert y la reimaginación de la gobernanza a través de tablas evolutivas y mínimamente viables
Nuevos modelos de toma de decisiones de liderazgo, alejando del modelo jerárquico a uno más distribuido

Reimagining Nonprofit and Philanthropy: Unlocking the Full Potential of a Vital and Complex Sector es una lectura esencial para todos los líderes, profesionales y donantes sin fines de lucro que buscan reimaginar completamente la forma en que las organizaciones sin fines de lucro piensan, operan y hacen un impacto.

title: The Routledge Handbook of Soft Power, 2nd Edition
description: The Routledge Handbook of Soft Power (second edition) offers a comprehensive, detailed, and ground-breaking examination of soft power – a key factor in cultural diplomacy, cultural relations, and public diplomacy.
translatedDescription: El Routledge Handbook of Soft Power (segunda edición) ofrece un examen amplio, detallado y innovador del poder blando, un factor clave en la diplomacia cultural, las relaciones culturales y la diplomacia pública.

title: The Technical–Business Equilibrium: Mastering the Art of Balancing Technical Expertise and Business Priorities
description:
Learn how to make the right technical decisions to achieve your organization's business objectives. This book is a guide for software engineers who are responsible for making technical decisions that impact the business objectives of their organization. 

You'll start by reviewing business priorities, technical decision-making, and see how to overcome common challenges. Using real world case studies, this book offers a comprehensive overview of the skills and strategies required for senior engineers to effectively navigate complex technical and business challenges. You will also gain advice on building trust and credibility with business stakeholders and communicating technical challenges and opportunities to them.

The Technical-Business Equilibrium reveals practical strategies for assessing technical feasibility and risk, selecting the best solutions to meet your company's goals, and communicating those decisions to business stakeholders.

What You Will Learn

Utilize techniques for evaluating technical feasibility and risk
Communicate technical decisions to business stakeholders clearly and effectively
Gain insights into managing competing priorities
Manage technical debts and build a solid engineering culture

Who This Book is For

Senior engineers with several years of experience in the software development industry who have most likely advanced through the ranks of technical roles and are now in positions of leadership or decision-making within their organization.
translatedDescription:
Aprende a tomar las decisiones técnicas adecuadas para alcanzar los objetivos de tu organización. Este libro es una guía para ingenieros de software que son responsables de tomar decisiones técnicas que impactan los objetivos de negocio de su organización.

Comenzarás revisando las prioridades empresariales, la toma de decisiones técnicas, y ver cómo superar retos comunes. Utilizando estudios de casos reales del mundo, este libro ofrece una visión general de las habilidades y estrategias necesarias para que los ingenieros superiores puedan navegar eficazmente complejos retos técnicos y empresariales. También obtendrá asesoramiento sobre la creación de confianza y credibilidad con las partes interesadas de las empresas y la comunicación de retos técnicos y oportunidades para ellas.

El Equilibrio de Negocios Técnicos revela estrategias prácticas para evaluar la viabilidad y el riesgo técnicos, seleccionando las mejores soluciones para cumplir con los objetivos de su empresa y comunicando esas decisiones a los actores empresariales.

Qué aprenderás

Utilizar técnicas para evaluar la viabilidad técnica y el riesgo
Comunicar las decisiones técnicas a los interesados empresariales de manera clara y eficaz
Obtenga información sobre la gestión de las prioridades competitivas
Administrar deudas técnicas y construir una sólida cultura de ingeniería

Quién es este libro

Ingenieros mayores con varios años de experiencia en la industria del desarrollo de software que han avanzado con mayor probabilidad a través de las filas de funciones técnicas y ahora están en posiciones de liderazgo o toma de decisiones dentro de su organización.

title: The Digital Transformation Canvas
description: The Digital Transformation Canvas offers a structured and practical approach to digital transformation that not only explains what it is, but also helps the readers identify new market potential and strategic projects. Digital transformation makes sense through the practical and comprehensive content, with checklists and workshop templates.
translatedDescription: El Canvas de Transformación Digital ofrece un enfoque estructurado y práctico de la transformación digital que no sólo explica lo que es, sino que también ayuda a los lectores a identificar nuevos potenciales de mercado y proyectos estratégicos. La transformación digital tiene sentido a través del contenido práctico y completo, con listas de verificación y plantillas de taller.

title: International Business, 3rd Edition
description: International Business: Perspectives From Developed and Emerging Markets provides students with a balanced perspective on business in a global environment, exploring implications for multinational companies in developed and emerging markets.
translatedDescription: International Business: Perspectives From Developed and Emerging Markets ofrece a los estudiantes una perspectiva equilibrada sobre las empresas en un entorno global, explorando implicaciones para las empresas multinacionales en mercados desarrollados y emergentes.

title: The Innovator's Dilemma, with a New Foreword
description:
The bestselling classic on disruptive innovation by renowned author Clayton M. Christensen.

A Wall Street Journal and Businessweek Bestseller.

Named by the Economist as one of the six most important books about business ever written.

Named by Fast Company as one of the most influential leadership books in its Leadership Hall of Fame.

His work is cited by the world's best-known thought leaders, from Steve Jobs to Malcolm Gladwell. In this classic bestseller—one of the most influential business books of all time—innovation expert Clayton Christensen shows how even the most outstanding companies can do everything right yet still lose market leadership.

Now with a foreword by Marc Benioff, the cofounder and CEO of Salesforce, Christensen explains why most companies miss out on new waves of innovation. No matter the industry, he says, a successful company with established products will get pushed aside unless managers know how and when to abandon traditional business practices.

Offering both successes and failures from leading companies as a guide, The Innovator’s Dilemma gives you a set of rules for capitalizing on the phenomenon of disruptive innovation.

Sharp, cogent, and provocative—and consistently noted as one of the most valuable business ideas of all time—The Innovator’s Dilemma is the book no manager, leader, or entrepreneur should be without.
translatedDescription:
El clásico de bestselling sobre innovación disruptiva por el reconocido autor Clayton M. Christensen.

Un Wall Street Journal y un bestseller de Businessweek.

Nombrado por el economista como uno de los seis libros más importantes sobre el negocio jamás escrito.

Nombrada por Fast Company como uno de los libros de liderazgo más influyentes en su Salón de la Fama de Liderazgo.

Su trabajo es citado por los líderes de pensamiento más conocidos del mundo, de Steve Jobs a Malcolm Gladwell. En este clásico bestseller, uno de los libros de negocios más influyentes de todos los tiempos, el experto en innovación Clayton Christensen muestra cómo incluso las compañías más destacadas pueden hacer todo bien, pero todavía perder el liderazgo del mercado.

Ahora con un prefacio de Marc Benioff, cofundador y CEO de Salesforce, Christensen explica por qué la mayoría de las empresas pierden nuevas olas de innovación. No importa la industria, dice, una empresa exitosa con productos establecidos se hará a un lado a menos que los gerentes sepan cómo y cuándo abandonar las prácticas comerciales tradicionales.

Ofreciendo tanto éxitos como fracasos de empresas líderes como guía, The Innovator’s Dilemma te da un conjunto de reglas para capitalizar el fenómeno de la innovación disruptiva.

Sharp, cogent, and provocative –and consistently noted as one of the most valuable business ideas of all time – The Innovator’s Dilemma is the book no manager, leader, or entrepreneur should be without.

title: Just Evil Enough
description:
Serious marketing books shouldn’t be this fun.

Marketing is about changing human behavior. Your product’s features are one way to do that—but they’re not the only way, and in a noisy world where making things is easy, they’re seldom the best one.

Yet product managers, makers, and challenger brands spend most of their time building their products, treating marketing strategy as an afterthought. There are hundreds of books on product innovation, but very few on go-to-market innovation.

So we decided to write one.

Packed with fascinating case studies and frameworks you can put to work immediately, Just Evil Enough is the result of nearly a decade’s research into system awareness, subversive thinking, and unexpected tactics by bestselling author Alistair Croll (Lean Analytics) and communications expert Emily Ross.

The book draws from behavioral economics, hacking, neuroscience, linguistics, game theory, and a wide range of other fields, it’s the book your competitors will wish you hadn't read.

Don’t take our word for it.

It might be hard to believe the authors of a book packed with mischief when we tell you that it will fundamentally change how you think about modern marketing. So here are a few of the comments we received from experts in psychology, marketing, product management, startups, and academia once they’d read the book.

“The genuinely subversive, joyful sense of mischief you’ll learn from this book is the one quality your competitors will find impossible to copy.”

Rory Sutherland, Vice Chairman of Ogilvy UK and author of Alchemy

“Just Evil Enough is a MUST-READ. I absolutely bloody loved this book and you will too.”

Cindy Gallop, brand and innovation consultant, former Chair of BBH US, and Founder of MakeLoveNotPorn

“Reveals the secret tactics of subversive marketing that give underdogs an edge. Packed with practical strategies and fascinating examples, this book is essential for any entrepreneur aiming to disrupt the status quo.”

Harley Finkelstein, President, Shopify

“Precision tools for subverting norms without causing harm. Bursting with well-researched strategies and surprising examples.”

David McRaney, author of You Are Not So Smart and How Minds Change

“I can’t wait to insist that everyone I know in marketing buys this book.”

Farrah Bostic, The Difference Engine

“Mixes sharp, essential theory with joyful, real-life-lived stories.”

Andy Nulman, Founder of Just For Laughs and author of Pow! Right Between the Eyes

“Packed with real-world examples and practical advice, Just Evil Enough proves thepower of refusing to follow the status quo.”

Eric Ries, author of The Lean Startup

“Alistair and Emily show you the angles and edges of what is being done to get consumers to buy. They also chart a path for all of us to be our very best by understanding why being just evil enough isn’t all that evil after all. A great and important read.”

Mitch Joel, ThinkersOne, Six Pixels of Separation, and CTRL ALT Delete

“A blueprint for turning weaknesses into weapons, outsmarting adversaries, and subverting norms.”

Colin Lewis, DMX/Marketing Week

“A rallying cry for marketers everywhere to stop writing press releases and instead find subversive, sustainable, brand-consistent ways to create attention they can turn into profitable demand.”

Scott Brinker, Martech

“Shows you how to think around the edges of problems to find unexpected solutions ... Claiming to give you a new toolset, it will, in fact, give you a new mindset—one that’s essential to modern marketers.”

Professor Stephen Kinsella, Head of the Department of Economics and Director ofImmersive Software Engineering at University of Limerick

“A must-read for anyone ready to inject some strategic mischief into their approach and leave the competition scrambling.”

Dermot Casey, CEO, IRDG

“How to challenge the status quo, outsmart the more game-theoretic actors in your space, and try unconventional methods to achieve extraordinary results.”

Jen Van der Meer, Reason Street

“Loved it. Super fun and engaging. The case studies are awesome.”

Ben Yoskovitz, Founding partner of Highline Beta and co-author of Lean Analytics. Yes, Ben wrote a book with Alistair so maybe don't trust this one as much as the others.

“Founders have accidentally become too conventional. Just Evil Enough is an extraordinary reminder that causing disruption rarely involves following the rules. This book shows you how.”

Raymond Luk, Flow

“This book has reshaped my perspective on innovation and is a must-read for anyone ready to outsmart the competition and lead with real impact.”

Barry O'Reilly, cofounder Nobody Studios, Author of Unlearn and Lean Enterprise

“Emily Ross is a not-so-evil genius and this book is a gem.”

Julia Hobsbawm OBE, Founder and CEO, Workathon
Still not convinced?

We get that. Skepticism is healthy. So here’s some unsolicited feedback from people like you who’ve bought and read the book.

This book is fantastic. It will be read from cover to cover and then all over again!
This just maybe the best ever book on marketing I’ve read.
This might be the most impactful marketing book I’ve read in almost a decade ... the most genuinely original thinking I’ve found since Play Bigger.
Most tech entrepreneurs, including yours truly, focus too much on product development and ignore marketing. If you’re ready to give marketing the attention it deserves, this is your chance.
I just hit chapter 5 and my eyes are bleeding, man. Staying up too late reading and then driving my team nuts with subversive thoughts.
Required reading on how to be different, which really is what marketing should be about. Break some rules or at least push the limits if you want to make things happen.
It’s been really interesting thinking of ways to apply what I’m learning in your book to the niche market of bespoke technical solutions in the Defense Industry. I’ve been particularly appreciative of how actionable the information is.
If I can’t convince my company to stump up for copies, I might just give out copies as gifts. I’ve been sharing the link to the recon canvas to a few people (BTW: the Recon Canvas section alone was worth the cost of the book!)
Am pretty gobsmacked. I wanted to reach out and say OMG your sh*t is fr*gging brilliant. LOL.
I'm 100 pages in and already shocked with how much they’ve packed into the printed pages alone!
As an owner of one of those 1,200 [First Edition pre-order copies], I can confirm that it is damn good.
An email about nothing else at all except to say I F**KING LOVE THIS BOOK. It is BRILLIANT. Congratulations.
175 pages in already and it’s amazing! I had to stop myself to take a break it’s so good.
Don’t know many people that want to read business books when sick in bed, but Just Evil Enough got me. I was a feverish mess yet still sneaking business tips, tactics, and inspiration instead of conking out. Not many business books can inspire me to turn a sick day into a strategy session.
This ranks up there with the best business books I’ve ever read and I’m already working on implementing a few of the ideas. I work in a big company and I now realize I have been operating somewhat subversively for years! Time to make it officially subversive… : )
For those of us in small business who need to wear a lot of hats, including hats that we may not have any real business wearing but rest on our head none the less, this book helps see marketing and our market in a different way ... great examples of marketing strategies that defied norms, took unusual advantage of opportunities, and made maximum return of investment dollars. If you want to rethink marketing or just get great handbook of real life examples of campaigns that made waves without breaking the bank, I highly recommend Just Evil Enough.
Highly recommend the material for founders looking for a novel and sustainable way to reach their customers.
Could be the greatest book since the bible…. Well done Emily Ross and Alistair Croll - this is truly a masterpiece.
I was definitely on the early ordering list for your latest book and am absolutely loving it. Thank you for sharing your brain with the world :)
Required reading.
Just a few pages in so far and page 9 greets me with a banger right off the bat: “Value isn't about the features you have. It's about the behavior you can change”
I just got my copy of Alistair Croll and Emily Ross's new book and man is it ever jam packed with useful stuff. I feel like I'll be consulting this book for inspiration on every new project, campaign, or go-to-market strategy.

Nothing in business works unless markets are correctly defined, mapped, quantified and segmented. Why else have hundreds of billions of dollars been wasted on excellent initiatives such as TQM, BPR, Balanced Scorecards, Six Sigma, Knolwedge Management, Innovation, Relationship Marketing and, latterly, CRM? The answer, of course, is because of a structured approach to market segmentation.

Market Segmentation: How to do it and how to profit from it, revised and updated 4th Edition provides a structured, no-nonsense approach to getting market segmentation right. It is an essential text for professionals and students based on a wealth of practical experience and packed with examples and easily used checklists.

Get your business up and running—and keep it thriving—with the latest edition of the classic entrepreneurial resource

For over 20 years, Steven Rogers’s Entrepreneurial Finance has been the definitive guide to setting up and managing the financial aspects of any small- to medium-sized business. But how can today’s entrepreneurs learn to thrive in the most difficult economy in generations? In this long-awaited fourth edition, Rogers updates his classic content for the 21st century, revising every chart, graph, and case study to reflect the modern entrepreneurial landscape.

Inside, you’ll find the most up-to-date information on writing a growth business plan, compiling and understanding financial statements, making a company profitable, valuing a company, cash flow management, debt and equity financing, and much more. The book is also packed with brand-new content on such current topics as:

Along with real-world case studies and detailed analysis, all-new classroom materials for MBA students, and a streamlined approach that makes the material more accessible than ever, Rogers’s updated content demystifies the ever-changing world of entrepreneurial finance and guides you, step by step, through the process of maintaining steady profitability and business longevity.

Whatever business you run or plan to launch, this essential guide provides the tools you need to build a sturdy foundation that will support it for many years to come.

title: The Art of Design Strategy: Tracing the Future of Design Innovation
description:
Although business leaders and designers may appear to have different objectives, they actually share a common goal: ensuring the long-term success and profitability of their organization. This book highlights the shared objective, examining the progression of Design Strategy to bridge the gap between design practice and executive decision-making. Featuring the TRACES framework, it aligns design initiatives with overarching business goals, enhancing design-led strategies.

The topic is a timely one. A recent article published by FastCompany has touched a nerve among design leaders, highlighting the urgent challenges and anxieties they face about the future of design. It’s sparked a conversation on the need for a new direction within the industry. As we stand on the precipice of the next design shift and design leaders ponder their next steps, The Art of Design Strategy offers a much-needed perspective, providing insights on how to elevate design to a strategic level and secure its place at the heart of business innovation.

What You’ll Learn

Understand the key principles of design strategy and management.
Build a design-led work culture within your organization.
Examine the TRACES framework to align design initiatives with your business goals.
Gain deeper insights of the future landscape of the design industry.

Who This book Is For 

Designers who are interested in design management and its implications, transitioning from design craft to management roles, and managers and design leaders who are looking to understand the strategic value of design in various business areas.

El tema es oportuno. Un reciente artículo publicado por FastCompany ha tocado un nervio entre los líderes del diseño, destacando los desafíos y ansiedades urgentes que enfrentan sobre el futuro del diseño. Ha provocado una conversación sobre la necesidad de una nueva dirección dentro de la industria. A medida que nos encontramos en el precipicio del próximo cambio de diseño y líderes de diseño ponderan sus próximos pasos, The Art of Design Strategy ofrece una perspectiva muy necesaria, proporcionando información sobre cómo elevar el diseño a un nivel estratégico y asegurar su lugar en el corazón de la innovación empresarial.

Lo que aprenderás

Comprender los principios fundamentales de la estrategia y gestión del diseño.
Construya una cultura de trabajo dirigida por el diseño dentro de su organización.
Examine el marco TRACES para alinear las iniciativas de diseño con sus objetivos de negocio.
Obtenga información más profunda sobre el futuro paisaje de la industria del diseño.

Quien Este libro es para

Diseñadores interesados en la gestión del diseño y sus implicaciones, pasando de la artesanía de diseño a funciones de gestión, y directivos y líderes de diseño que buscan entender el valor estratégico del diseño en diversas áreas de negocio.

title: Be Data Driven
description: Overcome the hurdles to building a data-driven organization with this roadmap to closing the skills gap, investing in the right technology and creating a successful culture.
translatedDescription: Superar los obstáculos para construir una organización basada en datos con esta hoja de ruta para cerrar la brecha de habilidades, invertir en la tecnología correcta y crear una cultura exitosa.

title: HBR's 10 Must Reads 2025
description:
A year's worth of management wisdom, all in one place.

We've reviewed the ideas, insights, and best practices from the past year of Harvard Business Review to keep you up to date on the most cutting-edge, influential thinking driving business today. With authors from Ginni Rometty to Robert I. Sutton and company examples from Maersk to Nvidia, this volume brings the most current and important management conversations right to your fingertips.

This book will inspire you to:

Reskill your organization in the age of AI
Rid your company of the obstacles that infuriate everyone
Understand what today's rainmakers do differently
Market sustainable products effectively
Choose the right sources of demand to grow your company at the right speed
Use strategic thinking to create the life you want

This collection of articles includes "Reskilling in the Age of AI," by Jorge Tamayo, Leila Doumi, Sagar Goel, Orsolya Kovacs-Ondrejkovic, and Raffaella Sadun; "How Fast Should Your Company Really Grow?," by Gary P. Pisano; "How to Sustain Your Empathy in Difficult Times," by Jamil Zaki; "The New-Collar Workforce," by Colleen Ammerman, Boris Groysberg, and Ginni Rometty; "Rid Your Organization of Obstacles That Infuriate Everyone," by Robert I. Sutton and Huggy Rao; "Where Does DEI Go from Here?," by Laura Morgan Roberts; "What Today's Rainmakers Do Differently," by Matthew Dixon, Ted McKenna, Rory Channer, and Karen Freeman; "The New Era of Industrial Policy Is Here," by Willy C. Shih; "How to Market Sustainable Products," by Frederic Dalsace and Goutam Challagalla; "What Does 'Stakeholder Capitalism' Mean to You?," by Lynn S. Paine; and "Use Strategic Thinking to Create the Life You Want," by Rainer Strack, Susanne Dyrchs, and Allison Bailey.

HBR's 10 Must Reads paperback series is the definitive collection of books for new and experienced leaders alike. Leaders looking for the inspiration that big ideas provide, both to accelerate their own growth and that of their companies, should look no further. HBR's 10 Must Reads series focuses on the core topics that every ambitious manager needs to know: leadership, strategy, change, managing people, and managing yourself. Harvard Business Review has sorted through hundreds of articles and selected only the most essential reading on each topic. Each title includes timeless advice that will be relevant regardless of an ever‐changing business environment.
translatedDescription:
Un año de sabiduría de gestión, todo en un lugar.

Hemos revisado las ideas, las ideas y las mejores prácticas del último año de Harvard Business Review para mantenerte al día en el negocio de conducción más innovador e influyente del pensamiento actual. Con autores de Ginni Rometty a Robert I. Sutton y ejemplos de empresa de Maersk a Nvidia, este volumen trae las conversaciones de gestión más actuales e importantes a su alcance.

Este libro te inspirará a:

Reskill your organization in the age of AI
Rid tu compañía de los obstáculos que infunden a todos
Comprender lo que los productores de lluvia de hoy hacen de manera diferente
Mercado de productos sostenibles eficazmente
Elija las fuentes adecuadas de demanda para crecer su empresa a la velocidad correcta
Usar el pensamiento estratégico para crear la vida que quieras

Esta colección de artículos incluye "Reskilling in the Age of AI", por Jorge Tamayo, Leila Doumi, Sagar Goelace, Orsolya Kovacs-Ondrejkovic, y Raffaella Chalun; "¿Qué tan rápido debería su empresa realmente crecer?", por Gary P. Pisano; "Cómo mantener su empatía en tiempos difíciles", por Jamil Zaki; "The New-Collar Workforce

La serie 10 Must Reads de HBR es la colección definitiva de libros para líderes nuevos y experimentados por igual. Los líderes que buscan la inspiración que las grandes ideas proporcionan, tanto para acelerar su propio crecimiento como el de sus empresas, no deben buscar más. La serie 10 Must Reads de HBR se centra en los temas básicos que cada ambiciosa gerente necesita saber: liderazgo, estrategia, cambio, gestión de la gente y gestión de ti mismo. Harvard Business Review ha organizado cientos de artículos y ha seleccionado sólo la lectura más esencial de cada tema. Cada título incluye consejos atemporales que serán relevantes independientemente de un entorno empresarial siempre cambiante.

title: Managing Public Relations, 2nd Edition
description: This book introduces students to the key concepts and practices involved in the day-to-day running of a PR operation, whether it is a company department, an independent agency, or any organized group focused on PR.
translatedDescription: Este libro presenta a los estudiantes los conceptos y prácticas claves que participan en la gestión cotidiana de una operación de PR, ya sea un departamento de empresa, una agencia independiente o cualquier grupo organizado centrado en PR.

title: Evolving Digital Leadership: How to Be a Digital Leader in Tomorrow’s Disruptive World
description:
Get ready to be an effective digital leader, influencer, disruptor, and catalyst for change in the digital world!
As a leader you need to constantly evolve to achieve sustained success. The world is being transformed by Digital. The pace of change is constantly accelerating and volatility and complexity are the new norms. Digital leaders are at the forefront of these waves of change, creating new markets and transforming traditional ones.
This book is a framework and set of tools that will help you develop a deep awareness of yourself, your teams, and your stakeholders. The powerful four-step process (designed to remain relevant over time) ensures that you are embracing adversity, driving disruption, and unlocking your full leadership potential.
What You'll Learn
Be an influencer, disrupter, and catalyst for change in a disruptive world
Know five key career recommendations from 40 digital leaders with more than 400 years of combined experience
Use the four steps of the Unnatural Selection framework to facilitate your personal evolution and digital leadership success
Demystify what makes people tick using the Human Full Stack, which is a model analogous to the technical full stack, so that complex behaviors are easier to understand
Embody intentionality to avoid distractions and achieve what’s important—your personal evolution, growing amazing teams, and influencing stakeholders
Who This Book Is For
Leaders who come from a technical background or are leading technical teams/organizations and want to be a part of building tomorrow's digital world
translatedDescription:
¡Prepárate para ser un líder digital eficaz, influencer, disruptor y catalizador para el cambio en el mundo digital!
Como líder necesitas evolucionar constantemente para lograr un éxito sostenido. El mundo está siendo transformado por Digital. El ritmo del cambio está acelerando constantemente y la volatilidad y la complejidad son las nuevas normas. Los líderes digitales están a la vanguardia de estas olas de cambio, creando nuevos mercados y transformando las tradicionales.
Este libro es un marco y un conjunto de herramientas que te ayudarán a desarrollar una conciencia profunda de ti mismo, tus equipos y tus partes interesadas. El poderoso proceso de cuatro pasos (diseñado para seguir siendo relevante con el tiempo) asegura que usted está abrazando la adversidad, la perturbación de conducción, y el desbloqueo de su potencial de liderazgo completo.
Lo que aprenderás
Ser un influencer, disruptor y catalizador para el cambio en un mundo disruptivo
Conocer cinco recomendaciones clave de carrera de 40 líderes digitales con más de 400 años de experiencia combinada
Utilice los cuatro pasos del marco de selección antinatural para facilitar su evolución personal y éxito de liderazgo digital
Demystify what makes people tick using the Human Full Stack, which is a model analogous to the technical full stack, so that complex behaviours are easier to understand
Intencionalidad de Embody para evitar distracciones y lograr lo que es importante: su evolución personal, el crecimiento de equipos increíbles y la influencia de los interesados
Quién es este libro
Líderes que vienen de un fondo técnico o son los principales equipos técnicos/organizaciones y quieren ser parte de la construcción del mundo digital de mañana

title: Business Ethics, 6th Edition
description: NEW EDITION, REVISED AND UPDATED This is a pragmatic, hands-on, up-to-date guide to determining right and wrong in the business world. Joseph Weiss integrates a stakeholder perspective with an issues-oriented approach so students look at how a business’s actions affect not just share price and profit but the well-being of employees, customers, suppliers, the local community, the larger society, other nations, and the environment. Weiss uses a wealth of contemporary examples, including twenty-three customized cases that immerse students directly in recent business ethics dilemmas and ask them to consider how they would resolve them. The recent economic collapse raised ethical issues that have yet to be resolved—there could not be a better time for a fully updated edition of Weiss’s classic, accessible blend of theory and practice.New to the Sixth Edition!New Cases! Fourteen of the twenty-three cases in this book are brand new to this edition. They touch on issues such as cyberbullying, fracking, neuromarketing, and for-profit education and involve institutions like Goldman Sachs, Google, Kaiser Permanente, Walmart, Ford, and Facebook. Updated Throughout! The text has been updated with the latest research, including new national ethics survey data, perspectives on generational differences, and global and international issues. Each chapter includes recent business press stories touching on ethical issues. New Feature! Several chapters now feature a unique Point/Counterpoint exercise that challenges students to argue both sides of a contemporary issue, such as too-big-to-fail institutions, the Boston bomber Rolling Stone cover, student loan debt, online file sharing, and questions raised by social media.
translatedDescription: NEW EDITION, REVISED AND UPDATED Esta es una guía pragmática, práctica y actualizada para determinar el bien y el mal en el mundo empresarial. Joseph Weiss integra una perspectiva de interés con un enfoque orientado a temas para que los estudiantes vean cómo las acciones de un negocio afectan no sólo el precio y la ganancia sino el bienestar de los empleados, clientes, proveedores, la comunidad local, la sociedad más grande, otras naciones, y el medio ambiente. Weiss utiliza una gran cantidad de ejemplos contemporáneos, incluyendo veintitrés casos personalizados que sumergen a los estudiantes directamente en los recientes dilemas de ética empresarial y les piden que consideren cómo resolverlos. El reciente colapso económico planteó cuestiones éticas que aún no se han resuelto, no podría haber un mejor momento para una edición completamente actualizada de la mezcla clásica y accesible de teoría y práctica de Weiss. ¡Nuevo para la Sexta Edición! Nuevos casos! Catorce de los veintitrés casos en este libro son nuevos en esta edición. Tocan temas como el ciberbullying, el fracking, el neuromarketing y la educación para fines lucrativos e involucran instituciones como Goldman Sachs, Google, Kaiser Permanente, Walmart, Ford y Facebook. Actualizado a lo largo de todo! El texto ha sido actualizado con las últimas investigaciones, incluyendo nuevos datos de encuestas nacionales de ética, perspectivas sobre diferencias generacionales y cuestiones mundiales e internacionales. Cada capítulo incluye historias recientes de prensa empresarial que tratan temas éticos. New Feature! Varios capítulos cuentan ahora con un ejercicio Point/Counterpoint único que desafía a los estudiantes a discutir ambos lados de un tema contemporáneo, tales como instituciones demasiado grandes como la cubierta Rolling Stone del bombardero de Boston, deuda de préstamos estudiantiles, compartir archivos en línea y preguntas planteadas por las redes sociales.

title: Innovation in Environmental Leadership
description: Innovation in Environmental Leadership provides fresh insights and critical perspectives on the vibrant and growing field of environmental leadership. It shows the latest state of knowledge on the topic and will be of interest both to students at an advanced level, academics and reflective practitioners. It addresses the topics with regard to leadership theory and environmental leadership and will be of interest to researchers, academics, and students in the fields of sustainability, environmental ethics, natural resource management, environmental studies, business management, public policy, and environmental management.
translatedDescription: La innovación en el liderazgo ambiental proporciona nuevas ideas y perspectivas críticas sobre el campo vibrante y creciente del liderazgo ambiental. Muestra el último estado de conocimiento sobre el tema y será de interés tanto para estudiantes a nivel avanzado, académicos y profesionales reflexivos. Se abordan los temas relacionados con la teoría del liderazgo y el liderazgo ambiental y será de interés para investigadores, académicos y estudiantes en los campos de sostenibilidad, ética ambiental, gestión de recursos naturales, estudios ambientales, gestión empresarial, política pública y gestión ambiental.

title: Entrepreneurship, Second Edition
description: Entrepreneurs who need to find the solutions to key challenges will turn to Bygrave. The second edition explores the trials and tribulations of entrepreneurship so that they'll have the necessary tools to start their own businesses. It offers new coverage on social enterprises and ethics due to the rise in green trends and corporate scandals. A new chapter has been added on entrepreneurial selling that examines how to sell to multiple stakeholders. New case studies have also been added to several chapters to provide more relevant views. In addition, updated examples and references are included to provide entrepreneurs with the most useful information.
translatedDescription: Los empresarios que necesitan encontrar las soluciones a los retos clave se convertirán en Bygrave. La segunda edición explora los ensayos y tribulaciones del emprendimiento para que tengan las herramientas necesarias para iniciar sus propios negocios. Ofrece una nueva cobertura sobre las empresas sociales y la ética debido al aumento de las tendencias verdes y los escándalos corporativos. Se ha añadido un nuevo capítulo sobre la venta empresarial que examina cómo vender a múltiples interesados. También se han añadido nuevos estudios de casos a varios capítulos para ofrecer opiniones más pertinentes. Además, se incluyen ejemplos actualizados y referencias para proporcionar a los empresarios la información más útil.

title: Effective Allies Don’t Just Offer Support — They Change Systems
description: People who engage in allyship in the workplace by supporting colleagues who face systemic bias have good intentions, but how they approach it matters. A meta-analysis found that the most effective allyship addresses the root causes of inequality, not just its symptoms. While signals of support validate people’s experiences, mitigating problems — removing structural barriers and changing biased workplace systems — is the most meaningful way to create observable, lasting organizational change.
translatedDescription: Las personas que se dedican a aliarse en el lugar de trabajo apoyando a los colegas que se enfrentan a prejuicios sistémicos tienen buenas intenciones, pero cómo se acercan a él importa. Un metaanálisis encontró que el aliado más eficaz aborda las causas profundas de la desigualdad, no sólo sus síntomas. Si bien las señales de apoyo validan las experiencias de las personas, mitigar los problemas, eliminar las barreras estructurales y cambiar los sistemas de trabajo sesgados, es la forma más significativa de crear un cambio organizativo observable y duradero.

title: Manage Your Workforce Ecosystem, Not Just Your Employees
description: Leaders increasingly characterize the workforce as being broader than an organization’s employees, encompassing all of the people and groups that contribute to achieving the company’s business objectives. The shift is challenging leaders to redefine who and what constitutes their workforce and to develop new management practices and organizational structures.
translatedDescription: Los líderes caracterizan cada vez más a la fuerza laboral como más amplia que los empleados de una organización, que abarcan a todas las personas y grupos que contribuyen a alcanzar los objetivos empresariales de la empresa. El cambio es un desafío para los líderes redefinir quién y qué constituye su fuerza de trabajo y desarrollar nuevas prácticas de gestión y estructuras organizativas.

title: Business Strategy (The Brian Tracy Success Library)
description:
Setting business strategy enables you to develop absolute clarity, establish priorities, organize resources and get better results than ever before. A strategic plan helps crystalize the future of an organization—mapping a clear path from where the company stands today to where you wish it to be.

It may sound complicated, but Brian Tracy knows how to make it simple. Throughout his career, he has shown countless leaders and organizations how to achieve stunning success. In this concise and practical book, he shares the most important lessons for strategic planning. Readers will discover how to:

Ask the five key questions vital to any strategic plan
Determine a corporate mission that lifts and inspires people
Gain valuable insight with market share/market growth and strategy/operations matrices
Define themselves in relation to their competition
Utilize the concept of "driving force"
Anticipate crises
Reposition their business with new products, services, and technologies
Measure success via clear financial objectives
And more

Incorporating examples ranging from Alexander the Great to IBM and General Electric, Tracy gives readers proven ideas for increasing their company's ROI and maximizing their strengths and opportunities. Powerful and portable, Business Strategy will help readers take control of their company's destiny.
translatedDescription:
Establecer estrategia empresarial le permite desarrollar claridad absoluta, establecer prioridades, organizar recursos y obtener mejores resultados que nunca antes. Un plan estratégico ayuda a cristalizar el futuro de una organización, aprovechando un camino claro desde donde la empresa se encuentra hoy hasta donde desea que esté.

Puede sonar complicado, pero Brian Tracy sabe cómo hacerlo simple. A lo largo de su carrera, ha mostrado innumerables líderes y organizaciones cómo lograr un éxito impresionante. En este libro conciso y práctico, comparte las lecciones más importantes para la planificación estratégica. Los lectores descubrirán cómo:

Hacer las cinco preguntas clave vitales para cualquier plan estratégico
Determinar una misión corporativa que levante e inspire a la gente
Obtenga información valiosa con el crecimiento de la cuota de mercado y estrategia/operaciones matrices
Definirse en relación con su competencia
Utilizar el concepto de "fuerza impulsora"
Crisis anticipadas
Reponer su negocio con nuevos productos, servicios y tecnologías
Medir el éxito mediante objetivos financieros claros
Y más

Incorporando ejemplos que van desde Alejandro Magno a IBM y General Electric, Tracy ofrece a los lectores ideas probadas para aumentar el ROI de su empresa y maximizar sus fortalezas y oportunidades. Poderosa y portátil, Estrategia de Negocios ayudará a los lectores a tomar el control del destino de su empresa.

title: Financial Times Essential Guide to Developing a Business Strategy, The
description: Whether you are intent on growing your business, or setting out on your start-up, this book offers an uncomplicated, practical and readable guide on how to get the strategy you need for your business to succeed.
translatedDescription: Ya sea que usted está intentando crecer su negocio, o establecer en su inicio, este libro ofrece una guía no complicada, práctica y legible sobre cómo conseguir la estrategia que necesita para que su negocio tenga éxito.

title: The Passionate Programmer
description: Success in today's IT environment requires you to view your career as a business endeavor. In this book, you'll learn how to become an entrepreneur, driving your career in the direction of your choosing. You'll learn how to build your software development career step by step, following the same path that you would follow if you were building, marketing, and selling a product. After all, your skills themselves are a product.The choices you make about which technologies to focus on and which business domains to master have at least as much impact on your success as your technical knowledge itself--don't let those choices be accidental. We'll walk through all aspects of the decision-making process, so you can ensure that you're investing your time and energy in the right areas.You'll develop a structured plan for keeping your mind engaged and your skills fresh. You'll learn how to assess your skills in terms of where they fit on the value chain, driving you away from commodity skills and toward those that are in high demand. Through a mix of high-level, thought-provoking essays and tactical "Act on It" sections, you will come away with concrete plans you can put into action immediately. You'll also get a chance to read the perspectives of several highly successful members of our industry from a variety of career paths.As with any product or service, if nobody knows what you're selling, nobody will buy. We'll walk through the often-neglected world of marketing, and you'll create a plan to market yourself both inside your company and to the industry in general.Above all, you'll see how you can set the direction of your career, leading to a more fulfilling and remarkable professional life.
translatedDescription: El éxito en el entorno de TI de hoy requiere que usted vea su carrera como un esfuerzo de negocios. En este libro, usted aprenderá a convertirse en un empresario, conduciendo su carrera en la dirección de su elección. Aprenderás a construir tu carrera de desarrollo de software paso a paso, siguiendo el mismo camino que seguirías si estuvieras construyendo, comercializando y vendiendo un producto. Después de todo, sus habilidades son un producto. Las opciones que usted toma sobre qué tecnologías enfocarse y qué dominios empresariales dominar tienen al menos tanto impacto en su éxito como su propio conocimiento técnico--no deje que esas opciones sean accidentales. Caminaremos por todos los aspectos del proceso de toma de decisiones, para que pueda asegurarse de que está invirtiendo su tiempo y energía en las áreas correctas. Desarrollarás un plan estructurado para mantener tu mente comprometida y tus habilidades frescas. Aprenderás a evaluar tus habilidades en términos de dónde encajan en la cadena de valor, alejandote de las habilidades de los productos básicos y hacia aquellos que están en alta demanda. A través de una mezcla de ensayos de alto nivel que provocan pensamientos y secciones tácticas "Act on It", usted saldrá con planes concretos que usted puede poner en acción inmediatamente. También tendrá la oportunidad de leer las perspectivas de varios miembros altamente exitosos de nuestra industria desde una variedad de trayectorias de carrera. Como con cualquier producto o servicio, si nadie sabe lo que estás vendiendo, nadie va a comprar. Caminaremos por el mundo de marketing a menudo ignorado, y crearás un plan para comercializarte tanto dentro de tu empresa como a la industria en general. Sobre todo, verás cómo puedes establecer la dirección de tu carrera, llevando a una vida profesional más satisfactoria y notable.

title: Leader's Guide to Negotiation, The
description:
PLAY ON YOUR TERMS

 

Negotiation is THE core business skill. It is fundamental to everything we do that involves other people, whether that’s asking for a raise, pitching an idea or deciding who gets the coffee.

 

The Leader’s Guide to Negotiation is a highly practical guide to getting the most out of your business interactions, whilst building stronger relationships to boot. From achieving win-win outcomes to problem-solving and building trust, it equips you with failsafe strategies for conducting successful and positive negotiations.

 

‘An entertaining, immediately useful book that goes beyond advocating for win-win – Simon Horton shows us how to get there.’

Adam Grant, Wharton Professor and New York Times bestselling author of Give and Take

 

‘Reading this book has made me think about how I negotiate and I have learned a lot… If you want to benefit your relationships while improving your business, then this is worth studying.’

Simon Woodroffe, founder of Yo!
translatedDescription:
PLAY EN SU TERMINIO



La negociación es la habilidad principal del negocio. Es fundamental para todo lo que hacemos que involucra a otras personas, ya sea que eso es pedir un aumento, lanzar una idea o decidir quién consigue el café.



La Guía de Negociación del Líder es una guía altamente práctica para sacar el máximo provecho de sus interacciones comerciales, mientras que la construcción de relaciones más fuertes para arrancar. Desde el logro de resultados ganadores hasta la solución de problemas y la creación de confianza, le proporciona estrategias inseguras para llevar a cabo negociaciones exitosas y positivas.



“Un libro entretenido y de utilidad inmediata que va más allá de abogar por ganar-ganar – Simon Horton nos muestra cómo llegar allí”.

Adam Grant, el profesor de Wharton y New York Times mejoran al autor de Give and Take



"Leer este libro me ha hecho pensar en cómo negociar y he aprendido mucho... Si desea beneficiar sus relaciones mientras mejora su negocio, entonces esto vale la pena estudiar.’

Simon Woodroffe, fundador de Yo!

title: Organization Development: A Process of Learning and Changing, Third Edition
description:
Master the modern discipline of Organizational Development (OD), and use it to plan and drive effective change. Organization Development, Third Edition is today's complete overview of the OD discipline for managers, executives, administrators, consultants, and students alike. Fully updated to reflect major changes since the classic Second Edition, it explains how OD is now practiced, and how it is continuing to evolve. The authors illuminate each key theory in the field, giving readers the background they need to translate theory into action, make key choices, help organizations learn, and lead change. Coverage includes:

What OD is, where it came from, and where it is headed

Understanding OD as a process of change

Defining the OD client (why your client may not be who you think it is)

Diagnosing organizational problems

Applying the Burke-Litwin model of organizational performance and change

Assessing how well OD techniques work

Working as an OD consultant, and much more
translatedDescription:
Dominar la disciplina moderna del desarrollo organizacional (OD) y utilizarla para planificar y impulsar un cambio eficaz. Desarrollo de la Organización, Tercera Edición es el panorama completo de la disciplina de la OD para directivos, ejecutivos, administradores, consultores y estudiantes por igual. Completamente actualizado para reflejar los cambios importantes desde la clásica Segunda Edición, explica cómo se practica la OD y cómo continúa evolucionando. Los autores iluminan cada teoría clave en el campo, dando a los lectores el fondo que necesitan para traducir la teoría en acción, tomar decisiones clave, ayudar a las organizaciones a aprender y liderar el cambio. La cobertura incluye:

Lo que es OD, de donde vino, y donde se dirige

Comprender la OD como proceso de cambio

Definir el cliente OD (por qué su cliente puede no ser quien usted piensa que es)

Diagnóstico de los problemas organizativos

Aplicación del modelo Burke-Litwin de rendimiento organizativo y cambio

Evaluación de cómo funcionan las técnicas de OD

Trabajando como consultor de OD, y mucho más

title: Hospitality Management and Digital Transformation
description: Digital advancements are ramping up guest expectations and introducing non-traditional competitors that are disrupting the hospitality and leisure industries. If organisations are to thrive they need to be in a position to effectively leverage digital technologies to improve efficiency, agility and guest experience.
translatedDescription: Los avances digitales están aumentando las expectativas de los huéspedes y introduciendo competidores no tradicionales que están perturbando las industrias de la hospitalidad y el ocio. Si las organizaciones quieren prosperar necesitan estar en condiciones de aprovechar eficazmente las tecnologías digitales para mejorar la eficiencia, la agilidad y la experiencia de los huéspedes.

title: Intuition, Creativity, Innovation
description: This book explores the scientific perspective on the concept of intuition, particularly in relation to vibration, music and emotion. Taking a multimedia approach, it contains practical exercises that will help the reader to achieve greater intuition and develop their capacity for creativity and innovation. The exercises in this book come from over a hundred workshops worldwide in both business and higher education. They include, for example, the “Mind Map of Me”, an introspective exercise designed to develop trust and confidence in the self and the reader’s own intuition. The book opens the field of possibilities to the reader, offering encouragement and motivation to explore new approaches and techniques. With these tools, intuition can become a valuable ally in everyday life.
translatedDescription: Este libro explora la perspectiva científica sobre el concepto de intuición, particularmente en relación con la vibración, la música y la emoción. Tomando un enfoque multimedia, contiene ejercicios prácticos que ayudarán al lector a lograr una mayor intuición y desarrollar su capacidad para la creatividad y la innovación. Los ejercicios en este libro provienen de más de cien talleres en todo el mundo tanto en educación empresarial como superior. title: Stakeholder Theory and Organizational Ethics
description: Business ethics is a staple in the news today. One of the most difficult ethical questions facing managers is to whom are they responsible? Organizations can affect and are affected by many different constituencies—or “stakeholders”—but who are these stakeholders? What sort of managerial attention should they receive? Is there a legal duty to attend to stakeholders or is such a duty legally prohibited due to the shareholder wealth maximization imperative? In short, for whose benefit ought a firm be managed?Stakeholder Theory and Organizational Ethics provides the most comprehensive, theoretical treatment of the stakeholder framework to date. Robert Phillips provides an extended defense of stakeholder theory as the preeminent theory of organizational ethics today.
translatedDescription: La ética empresarial es un elemento básico en las noticias de hoy. Una de las preguntas éticas más difíciles que enfrentan los gerentes es a quién son responsables? Las organizaciones pueden afectar y verse afectadas por muchos grupos diferentes, o por “partentes”, pero ¿quiénes son estos interesados? ¿Qué clase de atención administrativa deben recibir? ¿Hay un deber legal de atender a los interesados o está legalmente prohibido por el imperativo de maximización de la riqueza de los accionistas? En resumen, ¿para qué beneficio debe manejarse una empresa? La teoría y la ética organizativa de los interesados proporciona el tratamiento teórico más completo hasta la fecha del marco de los interesados. Robert Phillips proporciona una defensa amplia de la teoría de los interesados como la teoría preeminente de la ética organizativa hoy.

title: Protecting Your Company's Intellectual Property
description:
A company’s most valuable assets may not be physical. This book shows how to protect them without fences or security guards!

You can’t touch it or feel it. Sometimes you can’t even see it. Yet, intellectual property continues to soar in value, comprising an increasingly greater portion of a typical company’s assets. In the age of instant global communication, understanding what intellectual property is, how to protect it, and how to enhance its value are prerequisites for corporate survival.

Enter attorney Deborah E. Bouchoux and her informative book, Protecting Your Company’s Intellectual Property. Packed with fascinating and illuminating examples, this book is a succinct, yet comprehensive discussion of the four key areas of intellectual property: trademarks,copyrights, patents, and trade secrets. In addition to defining these areas (for instance, did you know that customer lists and marketing plans are protectable trade secrets?), the book offers practical tools for protecting intellectual property, including:

Trademark and copyright application forms
Sample employment agreements
An Internet usage policy
Tips on preventing unauthorized dissemination of information via the Web
A guide for conducting an IP audit
And much, much more.

Sin embargo, la propiedad intelectual sigue sumergiendo en el valor, que comprende una porción cada vez mayor de los activos típicos de una empresa. En la era de la comunicación mundial instantánea, entender qué es la propiedad intelectual, cómo protegerla y cómo mejorar su valor son requisitos para la supervivencia corporativa.

Introduzca el abogado Deborah E. Bouchoux y su libro informativo, protegiendo la propiedad intelectual de su empresa. Envasado con ejemplos fascinantes e iluminadores, este libro es un debate sucinto, pero completo de las cuatro áreas clave de la propiedad intelectual: marcas, derechos de autor, patentes y secretos comerciales. Además de definir estas áreas (por ejemplo, ¿sabía que las listas de clientes y los planes de marketing son secretos comerciales protegidos?), el libro ofrece herramientas prácticas para proteger la propiedad intelectual, incluyendo:

Formas de aplicación de marcadores y derechos de autor
Acuerdos de empleo amplios
Una política de uso de Internet
Consejos para prevenir la difusión no autorizada de información a través de la Web
Una guía para realizar una auditoría IP
Y mucho, mucho más.

title: Negotiation Essentials: The Tools You Need to Find Common Ground and Walk Away a Winner
description:
Actionable, easy-to-understand negotiating strategies you can use to dramatically improve your business, career, and personal life

Negotiations can be a perplexing and often-intimidating endeavor. Are there aspects about the process that are hiding beneath the surface, unknown to even experienced negotiators? Or insider tools that would change your game considerably? The answer is yes—and they’re all revealed in this practical guide from a world-renowned negotiation expert.

Negotiation Essentials demystifies this all-important subject, helping you break the process down into easily digestible parts. It covers the most important negotiating concepts, including the critical differences among great, good, and bad negotiators; choosing when, where, and how to negotiate; the art of saying no; understanding body language; how emotions, stress, and personal chemistry affect decision making; and behavioral patterns of the most successful negotiators.

Negotiation Essentials is organized into three thematic sections:

PART I: THE ESSENTIALS explains how to identify a negotiation, how to know who is winning, the important role preparation plays, creating a winning negotiating strategy, and more.

PART II: THE ESSENTIALS APPLIED starts with an assessment to see which areas of negotiation you need to focus on, then teaches the 10 phrases in a successful negotiation, 5 different negotiation styles and how to use them, and so much more.

PART III: BEYOND THE ESSENTIALS, dives into negotiating across cultures, the roles that emotions, stress, personal chemistry, and trust play in negotiations, the difference between face-to-face and online negotiations, and secrets of the award-winning Negotiation Economics philosophy—opening the possibility of achieving up to 42% unrealized value.

Filled with essential takeaways wrapping up each chapter, assessments, illustrations, color illustrations, and clear action steps, Negotiation Essentials concludes with a Negotiating Essentials Toolkit, which includes the professional negotiators pre- and post-negotiation checklists.

Whether you’re discussing a possible promotion with a supervisor, speaking to a potential high-dollar client, or engaging in a merger and acquisition process, knowing how to plan and conduct a successful negotiation is what will spell the difference between success and failure.

title: The Hard and Soft Sides of Change Management
description:
Change isn’t going anywhere. Learn how to manage it.

We live in a wild world of volatility, unpredictability, chaos, and ambiguity, with change seemingly as the only constant. Change can be difficult. It often induces resistance, panic, and fatigue. And, as you may expect or have experienced first-hand, many organizations aren’t handling change all that well, with many efforts resulting in failure. What you may not realize, however, is that some workplace change initiatives are stunning successes, rolling out smoothly and more easily embraced. Why do some change initiatives fail while others succeed? How can organizations and employees handle change better?

In The Hard and Soft Sides of Change Management, Kathryn Zukof offers practices and approaches to help you and your organization roll out, receive, and manage change effectively. Namely, Zukof shows that you need to manage the process (or the “hard”) side and the people (or the “soft”) side of change and find the sweet spot between the two. She demonstrates that when you integrate both sides, you and your organization can make change less of a hit-or-miss affair. Successful change management means deploying sound project management techniques that increase the odds of achieving the outcomes of your change initiative. It also means helping employees understand the need and vision for change, so they feel less threatened by it and become excited and energized by what’s ahead.

To deliver best results, you need to:

Define the change and how to get there—with project charters and plans.
Involve the right people in the right ways—from dedicated change teams to affected stakeholders.
Build support, understanding, and awareness—with communication, training, and resistance management plans.
Assess progress and adjust along the way—through action reviews and steps to tackle thorny issues.

Capturing the inherently messy nature of workplace change—from technology implementations, mergers and acquisitions, and business transformations to office relocations and more—this book offers tangible insights to help you and your organization tackle change challenges. Follow the book’s tools and practices to lessen the messy and objectionable parts of change and actively give your change initiatives the best chance for positive outcomes.

title: Think Like Amazon: 50 1/2 Ideas to Become a Digital Leader
description:
The former Amazon executive who launched and scaled Amazon Marketplace delivers the ultimate playbook on how to “think like Amazon” and succeed in the digital age.
“What would Jeff do?” Since leaving Amazon to advise start-ups and corporations, John Rossman has been asked this question countless times by executives who want to know “the secret” behind Amazon’s historic success. In this step-by-step guide, he provides 50 ½ answers drawn from his experience as an Amazon executive—and shows today’s business leaders how to think like Amazon, strategize like Bezos, and beat the competition like nobody’s business. Learn how to:
•Move forward to get back to Day 1—and change the status quo.
•Become a platform company—with the right platform strategy.
•Create customer obsession—and grant your customers superpowers.
•Experiment, fail, rinse, and repeat.
•Decentralize your way to digital greatness.
•Master the magic of small autonomous teams.
•Avoid the trap of past positions.
•Make better and faster decisions.
•Use metrics to create a culture of accountability and innovation
•Use AI and the Internet of Things to reinvent customer experiences.
In addition to these targeted strategies, you’ll receive a rare inside glimpse into how Jeff Bezos and Amazon take a remarkably consistent approach to innovate, explore new markets, and spark new growth. You’ll understand the unique mindset and inner workings that drive Amazon’s operational excellence, from its ground-up approach to new digital markets to its out-of-the-box attitudes on innovation. Along the way, you’ll learn specific game-changing strategies that made Amazon stand out in a crowded digital world. These include actionable ideas that you can use to transform your culture, expand your business into digital, and become the kind of platform company that customers obsess over. Rossman also offers invaluable insights into the latest technologies, e-commerce marketing, online culture, and IoT disruptions that only an Amazon insider would know.
If you want to compete and win in the digital era, you have to Think Like Amazon.

title: Technology and Innovation in Adult Learning
description:
A comprehensive exploration of technology's role in adult learning

Technology and Innovation in Adult Learning introduces educators and students to the intersection of adult learning and the growing technological revolution. Written by an internationally recognized expert in the field, this book explores the theory, research, and practice driving innovation in both adult learning and learning technology, and illuminates a powerful approach to recognize and leverage these opportunities. Building on current trends and research in technology and its use, each chapter illustrates the need, opportunities, and examples of current and future technologies that scaffold adult learning, and provides comprehensive coverage of both current and emerging challenges.

Many adult learning faculty, practitioners, and students realize that technology presents a growing and ever-present set of issues, yet few feel confident in identifying the opportunities that arise with each step forward. This book clarifies the interplay between adult learning and learning technology, and characterizes the cyclic exchange of information and opportunities that link these fields now and in the future.

Understand the critical issues currently affecting adult learning
Learn how technology is presenting both opportunities and challenges for the teaching and learning of adults in different contexts
Examine recent research on learning technology for adult learners
Discover how technological innovation can be applied now and how it will continue to shape the future of learning

Adult learning is on the rise, and there is no mistaking technology's role; whether they're learning with or about technology, today's adult learners come with unique sets of needs and skills that demand specialized approaches. Traditional pedagogical techniques don't transfer directly, and learning technology requires its own unique approach to development and use. Technology and Innovation in Adult Learning equips practitioners to further adult learning and shape the future of the field, while providing a rich perspective for classroom inquiry and research.

title: Fundamentals of International Business, 5th Edition by Pearson
description:

It uses the story of the ‘Wimbledon tennis ball’ to introduce students to the complexities of globalization and international business. It brings out the interconnected nature of culture through the case of Chicken Tikka Masala becoming a national dish of the UK. It highlights emerging issues such as the Robotic revolution in manufacturing, the appearance of mega-regional agreements, and the impact of climate change and global terrorism on international business.
